scientific_role: implementation-only coordinate correction of the mask-conditioned RAD-DINO descriptor extraction in rad_dino_mask_bag_mil_probe_val_v1; it does not change candidate masks, MIL losses, architecture, training horizon, output rule, evaluator, gate or operational goals

candidate_gallery_frame.operation: the classifier/CAM image is resized directly to 320x320; SAM proposals are returned/resampled to the same 320x320 direct-resize frame

rad_dino_frame.operation: the original radiograph is centered in a max(width,height) square, then resized to 448x448; tokens are a 32x32 grid in this square frame

incorrect_v6_operation.operation: project/run_rad_dino_mask_bag_mil_probe.py::_pool_one_bag passed the direct-resize 320x320 candidate mask directly to mask_pool_descriptors, which area-resampled it as if it already occupied the complete square token frame

affected_population_evidence.interpretation: the coordinate difference is widespread and is most damaging when a small proposal is shifted or compressed onto a few 32x32 tokens

bug_evidence.prediction_metric_boundary: The v6 WTA output remains an original frozen 320x320 proposal, so its post-freeze Dice is a valid deployable prediction metric. The bug compromises the causal test of correctly mask-conditioned RAD-DINO descriptors; it is not permission to hide or replace the v6 terminal result.

single_changed_variable.name: candidate-mask coordinate projection before RAD-DINO mask pooling
single_changed_variable.old: direct area interpolation from the 320x320 unpadded image frame to the 32x32 square token grid
new: map every output-square sample center through the exact source content_box and padded_side returned by the frozen square-pad transform
sample the direct-resize proposal continuously with bilinear grid sampling and zero outside the content box
use four samples per token axis, then retain the existing area interpolation to the 32x32 token grid
construct the original square-frame proposal once and horizontally flip that projected square mask for the flip-TTA descriptor
unchanged: all train and validation rows, group IDs and image labels
candidate generation, candidate ordering and complete galleries
RAD-DINO layers, random projection, descriptor content and scorer
16 final-only epochs, seed, optimizer and every loss weight
all 371 predictions, complete misses, evaluator, bootstrap and gate

required_tests: square-content projection places a direct-resize mask only inside the exact square content box
horizontal flip is applied after square projection and respects asymmetric one-pixel padding
fractional small-mask support survives projection and token-grid area pooling
original and flip retained-candidate indices remain identical
every unchanged image-only, T4x2, prediction-freeze and GT-import-boundary test passes

execution_and_decision.launch_condition: first complete and audit mask-bag MIL v6; a corrected rerun is eligible only if the v6 selected predictor does not already meet every operational goal and the immutable candidate oracle still meets every operational goal
execution_and_decision.monitor: one separate-task monitor at ten-minute cadence; no main-task polling
execution_and_decision.prediction_first: freeze source/protocol/split/checkpoints/candidate manifests/final checkpoint/history/all 371 physical maps and manifests before validation segmentation GT import
execution_and_decision.comparison: corrected-minus-v6 paired complete-group bootstrap with 10000 replicates, plus both arms versus the promoted flip-TTA baseline
execution_and_decision.gate: identical all-checks-required gate from the parent protocol; no post-result relaxation
execution_and_decision.consumer: forbidden unless the corrected source also satisfies the separately frozen post_prediction_consumer_entry_gate_v1

forbidden: changing any candidate proposal or using validation GT to route projection
tuning oversampling, interpolation, content box, loss, epoch, seed, threshold or gate after seeing corrected GT metrics
suppressing the v6 result because the geometry flaw was found
training a consumer before the prediction-first and consumer-entry gates pass
